newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, December slightly up.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, December slightly up.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed slightly higher with December up modestly, supported by mill buying, traders said.

Buyers included Peavey Grain at 1.0 million bushels of December, Wilson Trading 2.0 million and ADM 1.0 million, traders said. Selling was less defined but kept gains in check. Also, position squaring was noted before the release Monday of USDA's quarterly stocks report.
Underpinning the futures were farmers storing much of this year's crop in anticipation of higher prices. As a result, mills continue to be aggressive bidders for cash wheat, traders said.
MGE spring wheat closed down 4-1/2 to up four cents with December up 1/4 at $4.20-1/4 bushel.
